restore: copy <PRIVATE_CACHE>/lcr_v1_local_copy_20261007/lcr_v1 to <PRIVATE_CACHE>/lcr_v1 (only if the live store is lost)
verify: shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS (inside the copy's folder)

re-run the restore checks: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=. <python> -m lcr.sema --label F:closeout -- env OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=. <python> -m lcr.closeout backup --dry-run --targets <targets.json>
